A. Binary Array Game
time limit per test
1 second
memory limit per test
256 megabytes

Alice plays on $$$a$$$ where $$$1 \le n \lt 100$$$ and values are 0 or 1.

Use the following rules:

  • Choose a segment.
  • Replace it with one value.

See the announcement and .

Input

The first line contains $$$t$$$.

Output

Print Alice or Bob.

Example
Input
2
3
1 1 0
Output
Alice
Bob
Note

In the first test case, Alice wins.
